paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the change in loss across different training iterations for several configurations of "SepLLM" compared to a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale, spanning from 95,000 to 125,000 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and is also linear, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick intervals of 0.2. There are four lines depicted in the plot. The pink line represents "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)" with no markers and a solid style. It starts at more than 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and ends near 2.2 at 125,000 iterations, showing a consistent decline. The blue line shows "SepLLM (n=128)" with a similar solid style, beginning more than 3.0 and decreasing steadily to about 2.3 by the end of the x-axis. The orange line, indicating "SepLLM (n=64)", follows a solid line style as well, commencing more than 3.0 and declining to approximately 2.3. The dashed red line, labeled "Vanilla before post-training", remains constant across all iterations at a loss value of about 2.35. Each line demonstrates a uniform trend throughout the iterations with no major deviations, except for the red line which is horizontal. All lines have minor fluctuations throughout, and then each has variance in light color. A legend is given in top right.
